verdict_reason: Validated config record binds the TTL days from a property and backs both prod safeguards as the AC requires; one Minor hardening item on the fail-open environment check.

todos.issue: The code-level prod guard fails open: 'environment' has no constraint and isProd() is an exact match, so a null, empty (ENVIRONMENT= set to an empty string bypasses the ':local' default) or whitespace-padded value such as 'prod ' is treated as non-prod and both the stamping and the TTL-index guard pass. Low likelihood (days and expiry.enabled would also have to be set in prod), but it is the one safeguard meant to survive a config mistake.
todos.fix: Annotate the component '@NotBlank String environment' so a missing value fails at startup, and compare on a trimmed value in isProd() ('environment != null && "prod".equalsIgnoreCase(environment.strip())'); add the blank and padded cases to AddressTtlConfigTest.
